profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apptegy
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer I have clear that I must practice before I code for any project. I know that I do not have all the answers, but what is better: I can find a way to do things if I put my mind into it.

I have my own company called BcSoftware, we create the software MicE which is a Sales System, but after having explored all that I could in my position, I decided to join a Company in which I could be challenged further.  That is why I joined Crowd Interactive.

I have been working with Ruby and Ruby on Rails for over 3 years now, and it is awesome! I really enjoy how the community has helped me, and I hope I can someday help others grow and have fun while doing so.
